description: Measured Nemotron batch nemotron-fixed12 (12 fixed scenarios x 3 policies) from the checked-in evaluation adapter with the live NIM model enabled: 76 live Nemotron responses, 51 prompt-cache hits, 3 deterministic fallbacks. Mock preview copies the measured rows (apps/evaluation/results/nemotron-fixed12) into the in-memory client; it is never published to a live database.

manifest.cadence: event-driven cadence: called every tick on the same ObservedSnapshot as the baselines; re-plans only when decision_epoch, observation_event_ids, GPU availability/XID, node availability, cooling state, job status or signals change, or when a deferred mitigation's re-check is due (the planner's re-check time, >= 30 sim-s, while one is deferred), else returns [] (no new commands, no LLM call)
manifest.delay_label: job_completion_delay_s is a finite-horizon work deficit (lower bound truncated at the case horizon), not measured wall completion time.
